title: Unlacquered Brass Shower Curtain Rod Brackets For 1-Inch Rod, Wall Mount Solid Brass Pair, 3 X 2.25 X 3 In - Prestige Regal Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finish your shower with brackets that look built-in and stay solid for daily use—backed by a limited lifetime warranty — available in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. Crafted from solid brass and designed for a 1-inch diameter shower curtain rod, these wall-mounted brackets deliver a refined, traditional look.

  • Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Choose the look you want with a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes
  • Count on enduring construction—solid brass outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Prestige Regal collection

Specs

  • Product type: Shower curtain rod brackets (pair)
  • For rod size: 1-inch diameter shower rod (rod sold separately)
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting hardware included
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 3 x 2.25 x 3 in
  • Projection: 2 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 1.6 lb
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
meta_description: Solid brass shower curtain rod brackets for a 1-inch rod, wall mount pair with concealed screws. 3 x 2.25 x 3 in. Limited lifetime warranty.
